## README.md
# Sustainable Landscape Efficiency Frontiers — Input Layers (`public-nci-frontiers`)

H3-hexed input layers for the sustainable landscape efficiency-frontier analysis of
**Polasky et al. (2026), _Science_ 392:1069** ([doi:10.1126/science.aea9058](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aea9058)),
processed to cloud-native formats (H3 hex GeoParquet + visualization COGs) on NRP S3.

**License: `CC0-1.0`** (public-domain dedication). Input data are from the CC0 Dryad
deposit [doi:10.5061/dryad.qjq2bvqw5](https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.qjq2bvqw5)
(Polasky et al. / Natural Capital Project). No attribution is legally required, but a
citation to the paper and the Dryad deposit is requested.

## STAC

Catalog entry: <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-nci-frontiers/stac-collection.json>

## What's here

All layers are **raster-derived H3 hexes** (one row per H3 cell; no vector GeoParquet /
PMTiles). Selected layers also ship a visualization COG.

| Family | Native res | Reducer / semantics | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Economic production value** (revenue) | h5 (~9 km / ~8000 ha source parcel) | `mean` — per-ha USD **densities**; aggregate with **AVG**, never SUM. Negative = net loss | `crop-current`, `crop-irrigated`, `crop-rainfed`, `palm-current`, `grazing-return`, `forestry-return` |
| **Grazing methane** | h5 | `mean` — per-ha **density** (AVG) | `grazing-methane` |
| **Forest Landscape Integrity Index** | h8 (300 m source) | `mean` — index (AVG) | `flii` |
| **Land-use transition costs** | h8 | `sum` — per-cell USD **totals**; SUM is the catalog total | `tran-cost-*` (restoration, extensification, fixed-area, grazing/forestry expansion, …) |
| **Constraint masks** | h8 | `mode` — binary suitability / slope eligibility | `mask-irrigation`, `mask-rainfed`, `mask-expansion-suit`, `mask-slope-*`, `mask-sustainable-irrig` |
| **Carbon zones** | h8 | `mode` — zone ID keying the carbon lookup | `carbon-zones` |
| **Current land use** | h8 | `mode` — ESA CCI Land Cover 2025 class | `esa-lc-2025` |
| **Lookup tables** (non-spatial) | — | joined by zone / LULC class | `carbon-by-zone-lulc`, `predicts-crosswalk`, `predicts-sr-response` |

**Every layer carries an `h5` column** — the res-5 layers as native (parents `h4,h3,h0`),
the res-8 layers as an `h5` parent — so all layers meet at the paper's res-5 decision unit
(~8000 ha). `h0` is the hive partition key. Check each hex asset's `h3:native_resolution` /
`h3:parent_resolutions` in the STAC for the exact set.

> ⚠️ **Reducer semantics matter.** Revenue / methane / FLII are **densities** — aggregate
> across cells with `AVG`/`MIN`/`MAX`, **never `SUM`**. Transition costs are per-cell USD
> **totals** — `SUM` is correct. `nodata` (0) is excluded during hexing. See the STAC
> per-column descriptions for the exact value column and units of each layer.

## Usage

### DuckDB (H3 hex — the primary query target)

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
INSTALL h3 FROM community; LOAD h3;

-- Current crop revenue density (USD/ha) — a DENSITY, so average, never sum
SELECT AVG(crop_current_usd_ha) AS mean_usd_ha
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-nci-frontiers/crop-current/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet')
WHERE crop_current_usd_ha IS NOT NULL;

-- Restoration transition cost — a per-cell TOTAL, so SUM is the catalog total
SELECT SUM(value) AS total_usd
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-nci-frontiers/tran-cost-restoration/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet');
```

### MapLibre GL JS (visualization COG via titiler)

Raster layers have no PMTiles; render the visualization COG through a titiler raster-tile
endpoint:

```js
map.addSource("crop-current", {
  type: "raster",
  tiles: [
    "https://titiler.../cog/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png" +
    "?url=https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-nci-frontiers/crop-current/crop-current-cog.tif" +
    "&rescale=-2000,2000&colormap_name=viridis"
  ],
  tileSize: 256,
});
map.addLayer({ id: "crop-current", type: "raster", source: "crop-current" });
```

## Related catalog collections

For the biodiversity and carbon objectives of the same analysis, see
`iucn-richness-2025`, `wwf-ecoregions-2017`, `irrecoverable-carbon`, and `wdpa` (the
IUCN I–IV protected-area constraint).
